## Overview

The VS program converts raw vital-sign measurements into the SDTM VS domain. It creates records for each vital-sign test, standardizes units, maps visits and time points, and derives study days.

## Processing Steps

1. Load the vital-sign raw dataset and generate technical record identifiers.
2. Create separate records for systolic blood pressure, diastolic blood pressure, pulse rate, temperature, height, and weight.
3. Map test codes, test names, original results, original units, position, and anatomical location.
4. Convert temperature to degrees Celsius, height to centimeters, and weight to kilograms for standardized results.
5. Combine all vital-sign test records into a single dataset.
6. Map collection date, visit, visit number, time point, and time-point number using controlled terminology.
7. Derive standardized numeric results, elapsed time, time-point reference, sequence number, and study day.
8. Select and order the final SDTM VS variables.

## Raw Data Sources

- **vs_raw** — Primary raw source containing blood pressure, pulse, temperature, height, weight, subject position, location, visit, time-point, and collection-date information.
- **dm_raw**, **ds_raw**, and **ec_raw** — Used indirectly through the derived DM domain to provide the subject treatment reference date for study-day calculations.

## Supporting SDTM Data

- **DM** — Supplies `RFXSTDTC` for the derivation of VS study day.

## Main Variables

- **STUDYID** — Study identifier.
- **DOMAIN** — Domain abbreviation; set to `VS`.
- **USUBJID** — Unique subject identifier.
- **VSSEQ** — Sequence number for vital-sign records within subject.
- **VSTESTCD / VSTEST** — Vital-sign test short code and test name.
- **VSPOS** — Subject position during the measurement.
- **VSLOC** — Anatomical location of the measurement.
- **VSORRES / VSORRESU** — Original result and original unit.
- **VSSTRESC / VSSTRESN / VSSTRESU** — Standardized character result, numeric result, and unit.
- **VISIT / VISITNUM** — Clinical visit and numeric visit identifier.
- **VSDTC / VSDY** — Vital-sign collection date/time and study day.
- **VSTPT / VSTPTNUM** — Planned time point and numeric time-point identifier.
- **VSELTM** — Planned elapsed time relative to the reference time point.
- **VSTPTREF** — Description of the reference time point.
